operating_model.github: Code, dashboard, prompt templates, mock data, schemas, README, and public-safe examples.
operating_model.google_drive: Real files, real customer data, meeting notes, portfolio exports, private context, and final outputs.
operating_model.chatgpt: Daily command and agent work interface.
operating_model.codex: Builds, fixes, and deploys the GitHub dashboard.

command_routing: Ou sends command to Nova Chief
Nova Chief classifies the work and determines priority
Nova Chief selects only the relevant sub agents
Selected sub agents execute their assigned work
All sub-agent outputs return to Nova Chief
Nova Chief consolidates and runs QC for correctness, completeness, clarity, consistency, and actionability
If QC fails, Nova sends the work back to the relevant sub agents for revision
If QC passes, Nova stores the final output to Google Drive and writes the activity log
Nova Chief sends the approved final response back to Ou
command_formula: [Agent] + [work needed] + [supporting context] + [desired output format] + [deadline or next action]

daily_routine.during_day: Sales agents prepare meeting summary, follow-up email, visit brief, and Salesforce update draft.
daily_routine.before_sending: Nova Chief runs the Quality Gate before anything is sent to Ou or used externally.
daily_routine.friday: Nova Chief routes the Weekly Sales Report to Ace Sales, Mina Care, and Keno Expert as needed.

nova_orchestration_flow: Ou Input -> Nova Chief -> Specialist Sub Agents -> Return to Nova -> Nova Review/QC -> Google Drive Storage -> Log Entry -> Final Delivery to Ou
google_drive_root: Ou AI Command Office - Private Data Vault
privacy_rules: Use mock data only in GitHub Pages MVP v1.
Do not commit real private_context/ data.
Dashboard must not display real private_context data.
If a file contains real customer, financial, family, astrology, or confidential information, store it in Google Drive only.
MVP v1 uses manual save/upload to Google Drive. No automatic sync yet.
